tasks.title: Install fast-region ASDL vocabulary
tasks.detail: Implement the ASDL design now documented in docs/RESIDUAL_NATIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md under `Fast region protocol: residence, fallthrough, and bounded fusion`: NativeFastRegionPlan, NativeFastRegion, NativeFastRegionOrigin, NativeRegionBoundaryResidence, NativeRegionValueBinding, NativeRegionTransfer, NativeFastRegionBody, bounded Code expression/compare/memory/kernel/stencil region shape products, NativeFastPublicAbiShape, and NativeFastRegionCapability. Keep products precise; no generic context/table/map fields; no string opcode tags.
tasks.evidence: Implemented fast-region ASDL vocabulary in lua/lalin/schema/native.lua: NativeFastRegionId, NativeFastRegionPlan/Region/Origin/Body, NativeRegionBoundaryResidence/ValueBinding/Transfer/SwitchCase, bounded fast public ABI, Code expr/compare/memory shapes, kernel step and stencil point region shapes, and NativeFastRegionCapability. Added tests/schema/test_native_fast_region_schema.lua to instantiate the new vocabulary without generic maps/context bags or string opcode tags. Verified with `luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua && luajit tests/schema/test_native_fast_region_schema.lua` and `luajit tests/run.lua schema` (12 passed). Note: NativeKernelBodyRegion references existing LalinKernel.KernelId because the current kernel schema has KernelId/KernelPlan, not a KernelPlanId product.

tasks.title: Add fast-region projection methods
tasks.detail: Add leaf-method-owned projection from CodeFunc/CodeBlock/CodeInst/CodeTerm into NativeFastRegionPlan. Start with scalar Code expression regions: return atom, unary, binary, binary-imm-rhs, mul-add-imm, and compare-branch where locally typed. Preserve baseline NativeFrameMicroOpRegion for unsupported fast shapes. Do not use Lua opcode string scans or side tables; facts must be typed ASDL values.
tasks.evidence: Implemented Code fast-region projection methods in lua/lalin/native_code_methods.lua: CodeFunc:plan_native_fast_regions builds a NativeFastRegionPlan with typed frame/public/immediate residences; CodeBlock/CodeInst/CodeTerm leaf-owned methods project return atom, unary, binary, binary-imm-rhs, mul-add-imm, compare-branch, and baseline NativeFrameMicroOpRegion terminal/inst regions for unsupported scalar/control shapes. Added typed immediate patch coordinates to NativeResidenceImmediate in lua/lalin/schema/native.lua and updated docs/RESIDUAL_NATIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md so immediate residences carry NativePatchCoordinate rather than an untyped side fact. Added tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_projection.lua covering return atom/unary/binary-imm/mul-add/compare-branch projection and typed immediate coordinates. Verified with `luajit tests/run.lua schema` (12 passed) and `luajit tests/run.lua code_ir` (51 passed, 1 skipped).

tasks.title: Generate fast region template families
tasks.detail: Generate closed C-owned bank source families for NativeCodeExprRegionShape and bounded NativeFastPublicAbiShape. Include a fallthrough-capable extraction form where the template has no artificial successor jump. Immediate/constants/frame/public ABI bindings must be holes or typed install ABI coordinates, not family axes.
tasks.evidence: Implemented fast-region template source generation and tests. Changed lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua to generate NativeCodeExprRegionShape fallthrough sources and bounded NativeFastPublicAbiShape sources through typed ASDL leaf methods, added NativeExtractFallthroughFragment/fast axes/source input vocabulary in lua/lalin/schema/native.lua, wired extraction equality/support/generator verification in lua/lalin/native.lua, lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua, and tools/gen_lalin_mc_bank.lua, documented the extraction mode in docs/RESIDUAL_NATIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md, and added tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_template_sources.lua. Verified with `luajit tests/run.lua schema` (12 passed) and `luajit tests/run.lua code_ir` (52 passed, 1 skipped).

tasks.title: Teach graph lowering and installer fallthrough layout
tasks.detail: Lower NativeFastRegionPlan to NativeTemplateGraph/NativeBankInstallPlan with explicit NativeRegionFallthrough contracts. Extend generated C installer metadata/API as needed so fallthrough-capable templates are laid out adjacent and not patched as jumps; reject unsatisfied fallthrough layout with a typed install reject. Keep real branch/switch/call edges as real control transfers. Unblocked schema additions: `NativeAxisFastCodeCompareBranch`, `NativeAxisFastCodeSwitchStep`, `NativeCodeSwitchStepShape`, `NativeRegionSwitch.step_shape`, and `NativeBankSwitchStepEdge` now model compare-branch template selection and switch-step graph/install control explicitly.
tasks.evidence: Implemented T004 graph/install lowering in lua/lalin/native_mc.lua using typed ASDL: NativeCodeCompareBranchRegion now selects NativeAxisFastCodeCompareBranch families; NativeRegionSwitch lowers into per-case switch-step graph nodes with typed NativeSwitchStepEdge and NativeBankSwitchStepEdge, including per-case immediate bindings via NativeResidenceImmediate; generated C install ABI/continuation target recognizes LALIN_NATIVE_INSTALL_EDGE_SWITCH_STEP in tools/gen_lalin_mc_bank.lua. Added support/equality/source coverage for NativeAxisFastCodeCompareBranch and NativeAxisFastCodeSwitchStep in lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua, lua/lalin/native.lua, and lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua; updated Code switch projection in lua/lalin/native_code_methods.lua to carry NativeCodeSwitchStepShape/NativeRegionSwitch.step_shape. Tests run: `luajit tests/schema/test_native_fast_region_schema.lua && luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_projection.lua && luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_template_sources.lua`; `luajit tests/run.lua schema` (12 passed); `luajit tests/run.lua code_ir` (52 passed, 1 skipped).
notes: Unblocked after adding precise ASDL for compare-branch fast template axes and typed switch-step edges instead of string-dispatched lowering.

tasks.title: Use fused public/scalar traces in Code backend
tasks.detail: Route eligible scalar functions through bounded fast public ABI + expression region templates so `return a*b+imm` becomes one native region and no frame micro-op chain. Baseline remains semantic lowering for non-fast shapes, not a compatibility shim. Add graph assertions that fast regions produce fewer nodes and no artificial continuation jumps.
tasks.evidence: Implemented fast public/scalar Code backend routing. Changed lua/lalin/schema/native.lua to add precise NativeFastPublicCodeExprRegion body, lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua/native_template_support.lua to generate/select fused public-ABI + expression standalone C families, lua/lalin/native_mc.lua to lower public param/result residences to typed ABI register placements without patch holes, and lua/lalin/native_code_methods.lua to route eligible bounded scalar return expressions (including return a*b+imm) through one fused public expression graph node when the bank manifest contains the family, otherwise retaining semantic baseline lowering. Added/updated tests in tests/schema/test_native_fast_region_schema.lua, tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_template_sources.lua, and tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_projection.lua asserting one-node fast graph, fewer nodes than baseline, public boundary residence, no artificial continuation/fallthrough jumps, and typed immediate ordinal binding. Verified with `luajit tests/schema/test_native_fast_region_schema.lua && luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_template_sources.lua && luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_fast_region_projection.lua`; `luajit tests/run.lua schema` (12 passed); `luajit tests/run.lua code_ir` (52 passed, 1 skipped); and an ad-hoc generated fast public mul-add bank smoke that compiled and called `6*7+5 == 47`.

tasks.title: Benchmark and disassemble fast-region output
tasks.detail: Extend the benchmark/disassembly script to compare baseline micro-op and fast-region output for const, binary, mul-add, f64 add, branch, and switch. Verify the `a*b+5` fast path emits a compact fused sequence close to `mov/imul/add/ret` or frame-bound equivalent with no internal temporary spills. Run schema/code_ir tests and benchmark smoke.
tasks.evidence: Implemented benchmark/disassembly comparison in `benchmarks/bench_native_backend.lua`, added generated fast-region benchmark bank manifest `benchmarks/native_fast_region_bench_bank_manifest.lua`, and added const-return fast-region leaf methods in `lua/lalin/native_code_methods.lua` so const/branch/switch fast benchmark bodies do not depend on incomplete const micro-op fallback. Verified `LALIN_NATIVE_BENCH_ITERS=100 luajit benchmarks/bench_native_backend.lua` compares baseline vs fast-region output for const, binary, mul-add, f64 add, branch, and switch, writes baseline/fast disassembly, and verifies `fast_public_i32_mul_add` as one fused 11B node with mnemonics `imul,mov,add,ret` and no stack spills. Ran `luajit tests/run.lua schema` (12 passed) and `luajit tests/run.lua code_ir` (52 passed, 1 skipped).
